_meta.note: Snapshot of the Summit's assets, collected from the site repo (gcs-wealth-migration-summit) and the wm-summit sibling skills. Paths are relative to assets/. Updated 21 Oct 2026: 28 speakers (added José Carlos Reis, John McNertney, Francisca van Dijken), American Club partner logo added.

speaker_caution: Client-supplied headshot, as supplied (never generated or altered). 480×480 px — fine for slides and social, too small for print. Name and role are the site's card; a speaker's name is not tied to any session. Two speakers (José Carlos Reis, John McNertney) have JPG originals instead of WebP.
